family_reports.body: I've been robbed of being a full-time mother for with both of my planned pregnancies, missing out on school milestones and participation in learning, as well as missing years of goodnight kisses, trust in the system, and being forced to abruptly stop breastfeeding as my child was agreeable to weaning. It has caused continuous compound trauma that has impacted my daily life which the court continues to weaponize and also do nothing to reconcile the damage caused, eroding any and all trust in the system to protect my children from harm.

Arkansas allows parental kidnappings across state lines and dropping children off with open alcohol bottles in the car and is giving parents with past DUIs full custody and parents with clean records no due process.
